text:
sam: Partner Z dropped a reference arch + terraform module for marketplace onboarding. Need gating checklist.
nina: Repo?
sam: git.internal/redwood/partnerz/marketplace-kit — includes modules/, examples/gke, docker/ with arm64 Dockerfile.
leo: Gate: terraform docs, semver tag, CHANGELOG, LICENSE, CLA, manifest.json, multi-arch image + SBOM.
mia (partner-eng): For marketplace manifest include: id, version, maintainer, support_url. Example manifest: {"id":"partnerz-redwood-starter","version":"0.1.0","maintainer":"eng@partnerz.com"}
ops-bot: image-scan report: critical:0 high:0 med:1 low:2
nina: CI: matrix TF 1.4.x/1.5.x, run `terraform validate`, `tflint`, `terratest`. Add `marketplace-smoke` job to run staged deploy + simple inference check.
leo: Smoke criteria: deploy example to staging (cpu nodes), run sample request, assert HTTP 200 and median latency <200ms. If GPU required mark perf as informational.
sam: Add cost guidance in README (cpu demo vs gpu production), and include `./scripts/estimate-costs.sh` output.
mia (partner-eng): I'll run install in staging tomorrow and attach artifacts.
sam: Owners: Partnerships sign-off, partner-eng UX, eng-infra CI. Target merge Fri, publish staging Mon.
nina: lgtm
leo: lgtm
mia (partner-eng): On it, thanks!
